title: Repeat Overadvance Pricing — Fee Percentage by the Line's Overadvance History, Operating Lines of Credit
content:
The fee percentage charged on the overadvance portion of an Operating Lines of Credit advance rises with the number of overadvance fees already charged on the line in the past year.

## Pricing rule

The overadvance fee percentage is:

| Overadvance fees charged on the line in the twelve whole months before today | Fee percentage |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 2.0% (2) |
| Exactly one | 1.5% |
| None | The product's overadvance fee rate |

The count is taken from the line's transaction history: fee charges with the overadvance fee code whose dates fall within the twelve whole months before today.

## Percentages by product

| Product | No overadvance fee in the twelve months | Exactly one | Two or more |
|---|---|---|---|
| Borrowing Base Operating Line | 1.00% (1) | 1.5% | 2.0% |
| Agribusiness Revolving Line | 0.75% | 1.5% | 2.0% |
| StartRight Operating Line, ExpressLine Operating Credit, Seasonal Operating Loan, Revolving Operating Line | 0% | 1.5% | 2.0% |

The last four products permit no overadvance; their rows are shown only to complete the table.

## Illustration (hypothetical Agribusiness Revolving Line)

| Overadvance fees in the twelve whole months before today | Fee percentage on the overadvance portion |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0.75% |
| 1 | 1.5% |
| 2 | 2.0% |
| 3 | 2.0% |
